aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Putaruru, run by Anton and Morgan Middendorf. We stock and service the brands that get the work done: STIHL, Masport, Rover, Cub Cadet, Honda, Ferris, Fiskas and Silky. Whether you're after new gear or keeping your existing equipment running, we've got it covered.

We service what we sell and offer technical advice without the sales pitch. Buy online for home delivery or pick it up at our shop. Our team knows outdoor power equipment and can help you find what works for your place.

Come in and see us Monday to Friday, 7:30am to 5pm, or Saturday mornings from 8:30am to 12:30pm. We're here to help Putaruru keep its gardens and land in order.
